messages:
Ava: quick sync — post-launch SEO ops for the webinar + benchmark post. Need a short plan for redirects, schema, internal linking, and inbound lead routing to hubspot. Can we triage? Ping @Diego @Priya @Eoin :slightly_smiling_face:

Diego: on it. can someone drop the affected URLs/root paths? i'll sketch 301s and a deploy checklist.

Ava: here are the main ones: /webinars/redwood-inference-benchmark -> canonical /blog/benchmark-redwood-inference-2026; /signup/webinar -> /webinar/register; /resources/old-guide -> /resources/llm-serving-best-practices. Also old tracking links: /utm/sem-launch etc.

Diego: cool. first pass redirect rules (nginx-style) — i tested locally:```
# permanent redirect map
rewrite ^/signup/webinar$ /webinar/register permanent;
rewrite ^/webinars/redwood-inference-benchmark$ /blog/benchmark-redwood-inference-2026 permanent;
rewrite ^/resources/old-guide$ /resources/llm-serving-best-practices permanent;
# preserve utm if present (example)
if ($query_string ~* "utm_") {
  return 301 $scheme://$host$uri?$query_string;
}
```
I'll open a PR to eng infra for the edge rule. Note: set cache-control for 301s to reduce load.

Priya: tagging in keyword + schema notes. For the webinar landing & blog: primary KW "inference platform latency optimization" secondary "LLM inference cost reduction". Meta desc drafts: "Learn how Redwood Inference reduced per-token cost and improved p99 latency — webinar + benchmark." Keep ~155 chars.

Priya: schema suggestion (JSON-LD) — event + faq. Small snippet:```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Benchmark & Best Practices Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-05-12T16:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation","url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/register"}
}
```
Add FAQPage under the blog with 3 Qs about latency, cost, and deployment modes. This should help rich results.

Eoin: for inbound lead routing — we need utm+region rules. Proposed HubSpot workflow: if utm_campaign contains "benchmark" => set lifecycle_stage = lead + assign owner by region (US/EU/APAC) based on IP or form region field. Also tag source = webinar. Can someone confirm EU data residency for private customers?

Ava: good call. Legal/ops noted EU residency for enterprise leads — we'll set EU leads to the EU-marketing pipeline. @Diego can you add a hidden field on the webinar form for "region" (auto-detect fallback to user selection)?

Diego: yep. will add hidden form field region_detect and fallback dropdown. Form change PR will include GTM event for utm_campaign and utm_medium.

Priya: internal linking plan: 1) add 3 contextual links from resources hub -> webinar landing (anchor: "benchmarking inference"); 2) update blog cluster hub page with a callout to the webinar + canonical to main benchmark post; 3) add schema breadcrumbs on the benchmark blog.

Eoin: tracking checklist — ensure: UTM params preserved through redirect, GTM fires on final /webinar/register, HubSpot captures hidden fields and fires workflow, and conversion event recorded in GA4 and internal dashboard.

Ava: timeline: redirects + form changes by EOD tmrw, schema + meta by content by EOD today, HubSpot workflow + tests by Eoin by Fri. I'll compile a short runbook and share in the launch channel.

Diego: i'll draft the PR with the redirect map and link the infra deploy playbook. will add smoke tests: curl checks for 301 and utm passthrough.

Priya: i pushed meta+schema draft to content/seo branch. please review — i'll add FAQ Qs from the webinar script after the dry run.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: redirect-edge-rules -> staging at 2026-04-22T13:00Z. CI status: pending.

Ava: sweet — thx team. :rocket: I'll post the runbook and the checklist in #launchsquad and loop legal for EU routing.

Eoin: one more — can we add a short note in the webinar confirmation email to suggest related docs (link to resources). helps internal linking + retention.

Priya: done — added 3 resource links and canonical tag to the confirmation page.

Diego: smoke test results (after staging deploy):`200 OK` on final pages, `301` on old URLs, UTMs preserved. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234

Ava: perfect. closing the triage here — will follow up with post-launch analytics check tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
